issue_request: FHIR-17955 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Financial Management change request for the STU3 CERq/EligibilityRequest artifact. It asked to change the insurer short description from "Target" to "Insurer issuing the coverage" and to add "Link to ..." wording to item.supportingInformationSequence; the resolution also said to change the corresponding long descriptions and requirements.
initial_application: The large GF#17955/GF#17956 spreadsheet update f369c813fb touched CoverageEligibilityRequest and moved the insurer wording away from "Target", but it kept the active short as "Coverage issuer" and left item.supportingInfoSequence described as applicable supporting information rather than as a link. The 2021 source rework 33b409a4b6 converted that spreadsheet content into source/coverageeligibilityrequest/structuredefinition-CoverageEligibilityRequest.xml and preserved those short descriptions.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes CoverageEligibilityRequest the active current-build resource and records CoverageEligibilityRequest=EligibilityRequest as the renamed-resource relationship, while the legacy EligibilityRequest spreadsheet is no longer the current-build source. The related FHIR-17956 long-description issue is already represented on the combined branch by 4b383ed9ae, which fixed the long descriptions and requirements that FHIR-17955's resolution also mentioned. No Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/coverageeligibilityrequest/structuredefinition-CoverageEligibilityRequest.xml so insurer now uses the approved "Insurer issuing the coverage" short description and item.supportingInfoSequence now says it links to applicable supporting information. Updated source/coverageeligibilityrequest/coverageeligibilityrequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml so its insurer mapping exception mirrors the active StructureDefinition short text. Retired EligibilityRequest spreadsheet content and generated-looking SVG artifacts were intentionally left unchanged.
